notes: Option A: eight coarse groups for evaluation and reporting.
Each label lists fine-grained SCLC leaf ids from taxonomy.json via members.

labels.name: Fundamentals & governance
labels.description: Core vocabulary, theory, compliance, and professional security context.

labels.name: Identity & access
labels.description: Credentials, authentication, authorization, and account hygiene.

labels.name: Human & social threats
labels.description: Social engineering, phishing, deception, and user-targeted abuse.

labels.name: Defensive controls & hygiene
labels.description: Preventive controls, safe habits, endpoint hygiene, and resilience.

labels.name: Network & secure comms
labels.description: Infrastructure hardening, TLS, and protected communications.

labels.name: Malware & advanced threats
labels.description: Malware families, advanced campaigns, and sophisticated attack types.

labels.name: Applications & workplace
labels.description: Application security, insider risk, remote work, and location privacy.

labels.name: Other
labels.description: Topics outside the coarse cyber groups above.
